sources_read.title: Rasmussen, Floer homology and knot complements
sources_read.actual_fulltext_locator: Complete §9.1–9.3, PDF pp.71–79, including incidence surface, determinant loop, branch/node/vector field calculations and comparison argument.
sources_read.limitations: Source collapsed-tube and corner/representativity assertions are not adopted as proved local suppliers; new theorem proves only its explicit formulas.

sources_read.title: Lipshitz, A cylindrical reformulation of Heegaard Floer homology
sources_read.actual_fulltext_locator: Complete §4, PDF pp.18–30, as recorded in ROUND1; its Bourgeois quarter-index and Rasmussen comparison are imported there rather than locally derived.

mathematical_selfreview: Weak H1 bootstrap preserves only zero-order real-line boundary via tangential difference quotients; normal derivatives recovered from the equation.
Cokernel agreement proved by range intersection and dense image in finite-dimensional L2 cokernel, rather than asserted from kernel regularity.
Weights use smooth rho; nonsmooth absolute value is used only for H1 equivalence.
Actual determinant sign checked with orientation ds wedge dt: right cap +m pi, upper -2ell pi, left cap -m pi.
Source-cover, target-branch and node algebra independently computed in symmetric coordinates; no asserted quarter-index relation used.
Finite excision proof uses only finite rectangular/circle cuts and argument lifts, no full-AC triangulation or Stokes theorem.
